_what_this_is: The disqualifier set from scripts/squadnum/resolve-guard.js, copied from the live source 2026-09-16. Refuses a resolved page that belongs to a different TEAM within the same club, or a different SPORT.
_what_this_is_not: Not a club-name matcher. It is a veto applied AFTER a candidate page is found.
applied_to: the page title AND every collected label (infobox club field, category membership, Wikidata label)

second_independent_check.why: independently rejects both basketball pages the word list caught

token_matching_rule.why: club names take adjectival and compound forms. Lyon/Olympique Lyonnais shares no whole token; so do Chievo/ChievoVerona and Akhisarspor/Akhisar Belediyespor
token_matching_rule.deliberately_does_not_rescue: Sparta Rotterdam vs Excelsior Rotterdam, which is what the review flag is for

why_the_principled_version_was_rejected.the_principled_rule: the resolved label must add no significant word our club name lacks
why_the_principled_version_was_rejected.measured_cost: REFUSED 35 of 119 CORRECT pairs, 29% false refusals
examples_wrongly_refused: Bayern Munchen vs FC Bayern Munich
why_the_principled_version_was_rejected.why_no_amount_of_tuning_fixes_it: the BAD labels add CATEGORY words (women, basketball, II) and the GOOD labels add CLUB words (Hotspur, City, Olympique). No noise-stripping separates those two classes, which is what makes a principled rule impossible here
why_the_principled_version_was_rejected.what_shipped_instead: a narrow, admittedly fragile blocklist. Measured: 5 of 6 known-bad refused, ZERO false refusals across 119 pairs
why_the_principled_version_was_rejected.the_sixth_case: Sparta Rotterdam resolving to Excelsior Rotterdam shares the CITY, so no word list and no sport claim can see it. It is a REVIEW FLAG, not a gate: comparing the lead significant token catches it at a cost of 3 false flags per 119, which is a bad gate and a fine review queue

run_the_negative_control: a guard that never fires is indistinguishable from one that does not work. scripts/squadnum/guard-test.js is the control set; run it before trusting a pass rate
